name: [Sigma] High-Rate Automated SSH Scanner From Single Source
description:
One source IP opened 20 or more SSH sessions with a library/scanner client
banner inside a 1-hour bucket, which points to an automated scanner or
brute-force bot rather than a human.
query:
from cowrie-* metadata _id, _index, _version | where event.action=="cowrie.client.version" and (cowrie.client.version like "*SSH-2.0-Go*" or cowrie.client.version like "*libssh*" or cowrie.client.version like "*ZGrab*" or cowrie.client.version like "*Nmap*" or cowrie.client.version like "*AsyncSSH*") and not source.ip is null
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(1hours, @timestamp) | stats event_count=count() by timebucket, source.ip
| where event_count >= 20
false_positives: Internal automation running at high frequency (not applicable on a honeypot)
